name: popcornswap
rootCause: Another DeFi project popcornswap on Binance Smart Chain has gone. It is reported that some users said in the community that the project used cake's LP, the contract was open source but there was no audit, and the LP was run in less than two hours. Currently, there are more than 40,000 BNB in ​​the wallet and no action is taken.
